entity_raw.definition_raw:
Prerequisite(s): Gathlain, feather step spell-like ability.

Benefit(s): A creature under the effect of your feather step spell-like ability gains DR 1/cold iron for the duration of the effect. If you have at least 8 Hit Dice, the creature instead gains DR 2/cold iron, and if you have at least 16 Hit Dice, the creature instead gains DR 3/cold iron.
